title: 第11章 忌日
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
夜色如墨，将整个风云镖局笼罩在一片寂静之中。

    小屋内，陈安缓缓收功，一口浊气吐出。

    《鲸吞功》的修炼，让丹田内的气血愈发凝练，那股奔腾的力量感，无时无刻不在冲击着他的四肢百骸。

    二百八十公斤……

    这个数字，已经超越了镖局内一些的正式趟子手。

    “或许，该去试试现在的极限了。”

    他心念一动，推开房门，朝着演武场的方向潜去。

    然而，还未靠近那排冰冷的铁木桩，一阵压抑的、夹杂着痛苦闷哼的击打声，便从场地中央传来。

    陈安脚步一顿，隐在兵器架的阴影后，目光投了过去。

    月光下，一道身影正对着一根木桩，疯狂地挥拳。

    赵武。

    他身上还缠着厚厚的绷带，白色的麻布上，已经渗出了点点殷红的血迹。

    可他仿佛感觉不到疼痛，每一拳都用尽了全身的力气，动作因伤势而变形，却带着一股玉石俱焚的狠劲。

    汗水混着血水，顺着他年轻而扭曲的脸庞滑落。

    陈安沉默地看着，没有出声。

    “砰！”

    赵武又是一拳砸在木桩上，力竭之下，整个人踉跄着后退几步，靠着木桩大口大口地喘着粗气，双眼之中满是血丝与不甘。

    他察觉到了阴影处的动静，警惕地转过头，当看清是陈安时，那份戒备才松懈下来，脸上挤出一抹比哭还难看的笑容。

    “陈……陈爷爷。”

    陈安从阴影中走出，月光照在他那张布满皱纹的脸上，看不出喜怒。

    他看了一眼赵武渗血的伤口，眉头微皱。

    “伤成这样，为何不静心疗养？”

    赵武听到这话，情绪仿佛瞬间被点燃，他猛地握紧双拳，最终苦笑一声。

    “养伤？我怎么敢！”

    “林枫只用了半个月，拳力就到了二百三十六公斤！我拼了命，才刚摸到气血关的门槛！”他双目赤红，死死盯着自己的拳头，“我若歇了，就真的被甩得连影子都看不见了！根骨不如人，再不拼命，就一辈子都是废物！”
content_en:
The night was as dark as ink, shrouding the entire Fengyun Escort Bureau in silence.

    In the small room, Chen An slowly finished his work and exhaled a breath of turbid air.

    The practice of "Whale Swallowing Technique" made the energy and blood in his Dantian more condensed, and the rush of power impacted his limbs and bones all the time.

    Two hundred and eighty kilograms...

    This number has surpassed some of the official escorts in the escort agency.

    "Perhaps it's time to try your current limit."

    With a thought in his mind, he opened the door and sneaked towards the martial arts field.

    However, before they even got close to the row of cold iron and wooden stakes, a suppressed sound of hitting, mixed with a groan of pain, came from the center of the field.

    Chen An paused, hiding behind the shadow of the weapons rack, and cast his gaze over.

    Under the moonlight, a figure was facing a wooden stake, punching wildly.

    Zhao Wu.

    He was still wrapped in a thick bandage, and little bits of bright red blood had oozed out from the white linen.

    But he didn't seem to feel the pain, and he used all his strength with every punch. His movements were deformed due to the injury, but they carried a fierceness that could destroy both jade and stone.

    Sweat mixed with blood slid down his young and twisted face.

    Chen An watched silently without making a sound.

    "Bang!"

    Zhao Wu punched the wooden stake again. Exhausted, he staggered back a few steps, leaning against the wooden stake and breathing heavily, his eyes filled with bloodshot eyes and unwillingness.

    He noticed the movement in the shadows and turned his head warily. When he saw clearly that it was Chen An, his guard relaxed, and a smile uglier than crying appeared on his face.

    "Chen...Grandpa Chen."

    Chen An walked out of the shadows, and the moonlight shone on his wrinkled face, showing no emotion or anger.

    He glanced at Zhao Wu's bleeding wound and frowned slightly.

    "If you're injured like this, why don't you just calm down and recuperate?"

    When Zhao Wu heard this, his emotions seemed to be ignited instantly. He clenched his fists suddenly and finally gave a bitter smile.

    "Recuperate? How dare I!"

    "Lin Feng only used it for half a month, and his fist strength reached 236 kilograms! I worked hard, and I just touched the threshold of the Qi and Blood Pass!" His eyes were red, staring at his fist, "If I stop, I will be so shaken that I can't even see my shadow! I'm not as good as a human being. If I don't fight hard, I will be a waste for the rest of my life!"
